description: Guardrails for Ackman Calibration Agent (automation-05). Auto-approves weight changes within bounds — no human in loop.
approverPersona: Bill Ackman PM — reviews weekly evidence and ratifies bounded signal-weight updates

adjustmentRules.if: A signal dimension (fundamentals, catalyst, ackman_confluence, mispricing, social) had highest attribution score in weekly review AND fund beat SPY
adjustmentRules.then: Increase that weight by +0.02 (max +0.03/week), decrease lowest-attribution non-zero weight by same amount

adjustmentRules.if: A signal dimension had negative attribution AND fund lagged SPY
adjustmentRules.then: Decrease that weight by -0.02 (max -0.03/week), increase fundamental_quality by same amount (floor quality bias)

adjustmentRules.if: Alta conviction positions beat Media-Alta avg return by >2% over the week
adjustmentRules.then: May lower min_score_for_high_conviction by 0.02 (not below minScoreHighFloor)

adjustmentRules.if: Week had zero trades and zero exits and NAV move <1%
